metadata.disclaimer: Technical findings are potential risks for review and do not certify legal or regulatory compliance.

findings.title: Hardcoded secret
findings.description: A provider-style secret is assigned in source.
findings.remediation: Revoke and rotate the value, then load it from a managed secret store.

frameworks.explanation: This finding relates to identity and access protection.

findings.title: Hardcoded password assignment
findings.description: A password-like field is assigned a non-placeholder literal.
findings.remediation: Use environment injection or a managed secret store.

frameworks.explanation: This finding relates to identity and access protection.

findings.title: Potential SSN-like value
findings.description: A value resembles a US Social Security number; this is a review signal, not proof of personal data.
findings.remediation: Remove real identifiers and use synthetic fixtures.

frameworks.explanation: This finding relates to protecting data security.

findings.title: Sensitive data exposed in configuration
findings.description: A configuration field contains a sensitive value rather than a reference.
findings.remediation: Move sensitive configuration to protected runtime injection.

frameworks.explanation: This finding relates to protecting data security.
